English

[edit]

Proper noun

[edit]

Eine

  1. (Polari) London
    • 2015, Brian Fairbairn, Karl Eccleston, 1:42 from the start, in Putting on the Dish‎[1], spoken by Maureen (Steve Wickenden):
      Eine is the place to be.

Finnish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

A feminine form of Eino coined in the 19th century.[1]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈei̯ne/, [ˈe̞i̯ne̞]
  • Rhymes: -eine
  • Syllabification(key): Ei‧ne
  • Hyphenation(key): Ei‧ne

Proper noun

[edit]

Eine

  1. a female given name

Statistics

[edit]
  • Eine is the 324th most common female given name in Finland, belonging to 1,426 female individuals (and as a middle name to 443 more), according to August 2025 data from the Digital and Population Data Services Agency of Finland.
